units.source_text: 怎样才能达到那种声音、像柏木吹奏出来的那种不同凡响的声音呢？

en.t: How could I attain that sound, that extraordinary sound Kashiwagi produced when he played?

units.source_text: 我想，惟有娴熟才可以变为可能，美就是一种娴熟。

en.t: I thought that only mastery could make it possible, and that beauty itself was a kind of mastery.

units.source_text: 正如柏木长着一双丑陋的X型的腿，却能够达到了澄明的美的音色一样，

en.t: Just as Kashiwagi, despite his pair of ugly X-shaped legs, had been able to reach a tone of clear and luminous beauty,

units.source_text: 我也是能够通过娴熟达到那种境界的。

en.t: I too could reach that state through mastery.

units.source_text: 但是，我又产生了另一种认识。

en.t: But then another understanding arose in me.

units.source_text: 柏木吹奏的《源氏车》的曲调所以那样的美妙动听，

en.t: The reason the melody of Genjiguruma that Kashiwagi played sounded so exquisitely beautiful

units.source_text: 尽管有月夜那样的背景，

en.t: even with the moonlit night as its background,

units.source_text: 难道不正是因为他有一双丑陋的X型的胆的缘故吗？

en.t: was it not precisely because he possessed that ugly X-shaped defect?
